# External storage is blocked
External drives and other removable storage can't be used on this Mac.
This is a policy of {{companyName}}. If you believe you need access, please contact the Service Desk.
process == "diskarbitrationd" AND subsystem == "com.apple.DiskArbitration.diskarbitrationd" AND eventMessage BEGINSWITH "unable to mount" AND eventMessage CONTAINS "status code 0x00000001"
